finding.claim: Unauthenticated GET /rss passes the user-supplied `u` parameter straight to URI.open with no scheme, host or IP validation. An attacker can make the server fetch internal or loopback services and cloud metadata endpoints such as http://169.254.169.254/. Redirects are followed, including http to https. The first 400 bytes of the response are returned to the attacker, so this is a non-blind SSRF. open-uri also accepts ftp:// URLs.
finding.source: params[:u] (query string of GET /rss, no authentication)

trace.note: Route GET /rss has no auth guard
params[:u] is passed directly to URI.open
The first 400 bytes of the fetched body are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, scheme check, private-IP block or redirect restriction on this path. Sinatra adds no URL sanitization. TRUSTED is only used by /trusted.

verdict.reason: app.rb:8 passes unauthenticated params[:u] straight to URI.open(...).read with no validation, and app.rb:9 returns the first 400 bytes to the caller. The TRUSTED check at app.rb:14 applies only to /trusted.
